why: Intro to Rust plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-rust.json), 'Start a project with Cargo' (passes: cargo run builds the project and prints two lines). The learner ran `cargo build` after editing main.rs, cleared the terminal, then `cargo run`: nothing changed since the build, so Cargo prints only 'Finished `dev` profile ...' and 'Running `target/debug/trail`' (no 'Compiling' line) and the program's two lines. Exit 0. Done.

step.title: Run the project with Cargo
step.instructions: Change src/main.rs so it prints two lines: a greeting and how far you walked on day 1. Then run cargo run: Cargo compiles the project and runs it.
